title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
shortDescription: A large-scale flight simulation built around aircraft detail, route planning, and the pleasure of seeing familiar places from above.
highlights: Different aircraft make the same world feel mechanically distinct
Open-ended routes turn the globe into a calm exploration space

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A PC simulation anchor for the catalog’s breadth, representing a kind of place-based, systems-first play that consoles do not define as strongly.
